name: dpjob
description: DP Creation — Angular front end, Node/Express API, Firebase behind the API.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix angular-app install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix angular-app run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix angular-app run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
